findings.evidence: '`resources/theme-customization.md`: when writing `createTheme`...' while lines 80-82 load 'references/component-recipes.md', 'references/sx-and-styled-recipes.md' and 'references/theme-recipes.md'. findings.evidence: 'Search the whole repository, not just the file in hand, for the legacy APIs ... Migrate every hit with the v7 facts below, then typecheck.' This is a low-freedom, repo-wide rewrite with no scope check. A user who asked to migrate one dialog gets edits across files they did not name.
findings.fix: Keep the repo-wide search but gate the edits: 'Search the whole repository for the legacy APIs ... and list every hit. Migrate the hits in the files the user named. For hits elsewhere, report them with file and line and migrate them only when the user asked for a full migration or agrees.'

findings.evidence: 'Current MUI installation commands?' is labelled should_trigger false. It names MUI directly, so its label is ambiguous, and it is not a near-miss. Several positives are also terse fragments ('Stack responsive sx for small screens.') with no file paths or project context.
findings.fix: Replace it with a real near-miss, for example 'Our @mui/x-date-pickers DatePicker shows the wrong locale; fix the adapter setup' (false). Rewrite two or three terse positives with realistic context, for example 'In src/pages/Settings.tsx the Stack of cards overflows on phones; make it stack vertically under sm using our MUI theme' (true).

findings.evidence: 'Read the installed `@mui/material` version first (`package.json`, or `pnpm view @mui/material dist-tags` for the registry's current tags...' The live-read command assumes pnpm and gives no fallback for npm or yarn repositories.
findings.fix: Use the package manager's own command: '`npm view @mui/material dist-tags` (or `pnpm view` / `yarn npm info` in those repos)'. To read the installed version rather than the registry, use '`npm ls @mui/material`'.
